When on this amazing island beach you will not only have access to amazing snorkeling, you will find yourself amidst some of the best shelling in the world. CJ REEF, a Florida hidden gem is certain to leave you speechless. So book your adventure

services.name: Dolphin Boat Cruise
services.desc: This two hour cruise is certain to leave you speechless! Duration 2 Hours About We'll tour the island around Sanibel, Fort Myers Beach while you feel the kiss of the SW Florida sun and the breeze upon your face. Chances are we'll see Turtles, Dolphins, Manatees, and maybe even an Eagle Ray. This trip is perfect for those of us that love life on the water and want to relax and let the sun melt our cares away. Please Note There is a minimum of 2 people required on this boat
